title: Sheets
description: Drawing sheets of the project: every page of the PDFs and DWGs in the Shared and Published folders, with number, title and revision read from the title block. Group them into sheet sets and publish an issue.
rescanHint: Reads the sheets of every drawing in the folders chosen in Project Settings → CDE again.
rescanQueued_one: {{count}} drawing queued; the sheets appear in a moment.
rescanQueued_other: {{count}} drawings queued; the sheets appear in a moment.

empty.title: No sheets yet
empty.set: This set has no sheets you can see
empty.hint: Upload PDF or DWG drawings into a Shared or Published folder; each page becomes a sheet. Project administrators choose the folders in Project Settings → CDE.

sets.title: Sheet Sets
sets.namePrompt: Name of the set, for example "Tender Set" or "Construction Issue 03".
sets.deleteConfirm: Delete the sheet set {{name}} and its published issues? The drawings themselves are not deleted.

publish.title: Publish {{name}}
publish.explain_one: Issue {{no}} records the current revision of {{count}} sheet. Later revisions do not change a published issue.
publish.explain_other: Issue {{no}} records the current revision of {{count}} sheets. Later revisions do not change a published issue.

detail.title: Sheet
detail.edited: Edited by hand: reading the drawing again keeps these details.

settings.title: Sheets
settings.description: PDF and DWG drawings uploaded into these folders are split into sheets (one per page) and their title blocks are read.
settings.saved: Sheet settings saved. Use Read Again on the Sheets page for drawings already uploaded.
settings.templateNone: No template: number, title and revision are found automatically.
settings.templateSet: Template drawn for {{orientations}} sheets; automatic reading fills what it does not map.
settings.templateHow: To draw or change it, open a sheet on the Sheets page and choose Title-Block Template.
settings.templateRemoved: Title-block template removed. Use Read Again on the Sheets page to read the drawings without it.
settings.ocrHint: Pages without text are read on this server (English and Turkish), only in the title block. Nothing is sent anywhere. Values read by OCR are marked for checking.
settings.ocrInstanceOff: OCR is switched off for the installation (Administration → Privacy).

ocr.badgeHint: Number, title and revision were read from a scanned page by text recognition (confidence {{percent}} %). Check them and correct them if needed.

admin.title: Text Recognition (OCR) for Scanned Drawings
admin.description: Scanned sheets get their title block read by OCR on this server ({{languages}}, {{dpi}} dpi). The language data is installed with SiteKeep; nothing is downloaded or sent. Projects can switch it off in their sheet settings.

template.title: Title-Block Template

appliesTo.landscape: Applies to every landscape sheet of the project (all paper sizes).
appliesTo.portrait: Applies to every portrait sheet of the project (all paper sizes).

template.hintRegion: Drag a rectangle around the title block.
template.hintField: Drag a rectangle around the {{field}} value, or type the label printed next to it.
template.noRegion: Draw the title block first, then map its fields.
template.label: Label Keyword
template.fallback: Fields without an area or label, and fields not found, are read automatically.
template.saved: Title-block template saved. Use Read Again to apply it to the drawings already uploaded.
template.savedReading_one: Title-block template saved; {{count}} drawing is being read again.
template.savedReading_other: Title-block template saved; {{count}} drawings are being read again.
